_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F24, a rescue: Mira, Kai's little sister (trust + 1; the village).

text.zh_TW: 最裡面的房間裡，一個綁著辮子的女孩正在用湯匙挖牆。凱的劍掉在地上。「……米菈？」
text.en: In the innermost room, a girl with braids is digging at the wall with a spoon. Kai's sword clatters to the floor. "...Mira?"

text.zh_TW: 米菈：「哥！？你、你怎麼現在才來！我已經挖了三天了！」她撲進凱的懷裡。凱的聲音在發抖：「……對不起。對不起。」
text.en: Mira: "Big brother!? Wh-why are you only coming now! I've been digging for three days!" She throws herself into Kai's arms. Kai's voice shakes. "...I'm sorry. I'm sorry."

text.zh_TW: 凱轉過身，眼睛紅紅的：「里歐……謝謝你。我欠你一條命。」他把米菈交給村民：「先跟他們去村子。哥哥還有事要做。」
text.en: Kai turns round, eyes red. "Leo... thank you. I owe you a life." He hands Mira over to the villagers. "Go to the village with them first. Your brother still has work to do."
